subject: Coord: Hosted API integration deep-dive (SDKs, streaming, tooling)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dubois <alex.dubois@carelytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API integration deep-dive (SDKs, streaming, tooling)

Alex —

Thanks again for the time on the call last week. As discussed, we’d like to run a focused technical deep-dive to align on the Hosted API integration surface so your engineers are confident about SDK usage, streaming patterns, and function/tool calling. Proposed goals:

- Walk through Redwood SDK call patterns (sync vs streaming)
- Streaming best practices (prefix caching, continuous batching)
- Tool / function-calling semantics and sample payloads
- Auth, rate limits, and retry/backoff behavior
- Deployment considerations for low-latency paths (region & routing)

Suggested session length: 45 minutes (30–45 min + 15 min buffer for Q&A). Proposed slots (Pacific / Eastern displayed):
- Tue Jun 9, 10:00–10:45 PT / 13:00–13:45 ET
- Thu Jun 11, 09:00–09:45 PT / 12:00–12:45 ET

Can you confirm which slot works for Carelytics and who from your side should join? We’ll bring an SDK engineer (Jonas) and an infra architect (Soojin). Attached is a short proposed agenda and a high-level platform diagram.

If those times don’t work, share a couple alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed-agenda.md (text), platform-arch-diagram.png (image)
From: Alex Dubois <alex.dubois@carelytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: healthsync-demo+ops@carelytics.com, javier@carelytics.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration deep-dive (SDKs, streaming, tooling)

Thanks Karthik — this looks great. Javier (our platform engineer) and I will attend. Prefer the Tue Jun 9 slot if possible but we only need 30–40 minutes.

Quick notes from our side:
- We’ll want to focus on streaming and KV prefix/caching — that’s our biggest cost/latency risk right now.
- We have a strict proxy/firewall setup; please include any network/port hints we should surface to infra.

Tue Jun 9 at 13:00 ET works for us. If you need a shorter slot we can do 30 minutes.

Alex
Director of Product, Carelytics
alex.dubois@carelytics.com

Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration deep-dive (SDKs, streaming, tooling)

Alex / Karthik —

Quick update: Karthik looped me in to coordinate logistics. Unfortunately Jonas is booked at 10:00 PT on Tue (customer briefing overrun). Would you be open to moving the session 45 minutes later the same day or shifting to Thu Jun 11 at 09:00 PT? Options:

- Tue Jun 9, 10:45–11:30 PT / 13:45–14:30 ET (Jonas can make the last 30 min)
- Thu Jun 11, 09:00–09:45 PT / 12:00–12:45 ET (full team available)

We’ll keep it framed as a 30–45 minute technical walk-through. Also:
- Jonas will prepare a short code sample showing a streaming client with reconnect/backoff.
- Soojin will bring a note on caching/kv prefix patterns for your use case.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Marissa — Thu the 11th at 12:00 ET (09:00 PT) works better for our infra folks. Please go ahead and schedule for that slot.

Attendees from Carelytics: Alex Dubois (Product), Javier Morales (Platform), Tara Singh (Backend lead)
Attendees from Redwood: Karthik, Jonas (SDK), Soojin (Infra), Marissa (AE)

I’ve created a calendar invite and attached a short firewall checklist you can share with your engineers in advance. Can you also drop any client-side sample code beforehand if possible? Even a 2–3 line snippet we can run to sanity-check connectivity would be helpful.

Looking forward to it.

Alex
Director of Product, Carelytics
alex.dubois@carelytics.com

Attachments: carelytics-firewall-checklist.pdf
